description: Implementation of the ProductService interface, providing business logic for managing Product entities in an e-commerce system, including CRUD operations, indexing, and related entity management.

classes.name: ProductServiceImpl
classes.description: A service class implementing the ProductService interface to handle business logic related to Product entities, including CRUD operations, indexing, and handling related entity associations.

methods.name: addProductDescription
methods.description: Adds a product description to a product and updates the index.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves a list of products filtered by category IDs, with optional locale filtering.

methods.name: getProductDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the product description matching the specified language.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Fetches a product by its SEO-friendly URL within a merchant store.

methods.name: getProductForLocale
methods.description: Returns product data localized to a specific language and locale.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists products available in a specific merchant store, optionally filtered by search criteria.

methods.name: listByTaxClass
methods.description: Lists products associated with a given tax class.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a product based on its product code for a specified language.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a product, including its images, relationships, and index entry.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new product and indexes it.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new product or updates an existing one, managing associated entities and reindexing.
